directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: 搔 was not flagged: the dictionary writes the long 乀 of 叉 before its two marks while Ja writes the centre mark first, and every stroke keeps a similar direction, so the order difference only appeared on the sheet. Corrected as a reorder, not a direction edit.

subThresholdSlants.method: direction-probe.mjs rows with an angle of 45° to 60°: 10 rows, none direction-corrected; 嗇2, 簫14, 簫17 and 蕭15 were pairings of strokes that the reorders realigned
subThresholdSlants.note: The other six are short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them, below the inspection threshold. Kept as licensed geometry, as in the earlier batches.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); the offset does not change stroke directions.
